31.old: BC Transit’s Central Fraser Valley route list includes Mission routes 31 Valley Connector, 32 West Heights, 33 Cedar Valley, 34 East Side, 35 Hatzic and 39 Shopper Shuttle
31.new: Routes 31 Valley Connector and 32 West Heights appear on BC Transit’s Central Fraser Valley route list as Mission routes, as do 33 Cedar Valley and 34 East Side, plus 35 Hatzic and 39 Shopper Shuttle

33.old: TransLink says the West Coast Express travels between Downtown Vancouver and Mission City on weekdays during morning and evening rush hours, westbound only in the mornings and eastbound only in the afternoon and evening
33.new: TransLink’s West Coast Express serves Mission City from Downtown Vancouver on weekdays, at rush hour only. West Mission riders will find it runs westbound in the mornings and eastbound in the afternoon and evenings, never the reverse

51.old: Mission is in School District 75 (Mission Public Schools). Names, grades and addresses from the Province’s SD75 school list and each school’s page. Checked against the official pages on October 18, 2026.
51.new: Mission belongs to School District 75, known as Mission Public Schools. Names, grades and addresses are taken from each school’s own page and the school list the Province publishes for SD75, and the official pages were checked on October 18, 2026.

89.old: The City lists Monday to Friday 5:30 a.m. to 10 p.m., Saturday 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. and Sunday 7 a.m. to 9 p.m., with shorter hours on statutory holidays. Check the City’s status page before you go
89.new: The City opens at 5:30 a.m. Monday to Friday and closes at 10 p.m., and on Saturday the hours are 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. Sunday hours are 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Statutory holidays run shorter, so the City’s status page is worth a look before you head over

95.old: Playgrounds for ages 0 to 5 and 6 to 12, tennis courts, a lacrosse box, outdoor fitness equipment, an off-leash dog area, paved trails, picnic tables, a washroom and a nine-hole disc golf course
95.new: Facilities include a nine-hole disc golf course, an off-leash dog area, a washroom, picnic tables, paved trails, a lacrosse box, tennis courts and outdoor fitness equipment, along with play areas for the 0 to 5 and 6 to 12 age groups

97.old: The City says the Mission City Farmers Market runs there in the spring and summer, and the annual Lights On! Tree Lighting is held there
97.new: Spring and summer is when the Mission City Farmers Market operates at the site, the City says, and the site is also the setting for the yearly Lights On! Tree Lighting

99.old: A Japanese Tea House is being developed in the park. The City’s project page gives the address as 7871 Taulbut Street and says construction is expected to begin in October 2026, with an opening event in early 2027
99.new: There is a Japanese Tea House under development in the park, and according to the City’s project page it sits at 7871 Taulbut Street. Work is expected to start in October 2026, and an opening event is planned for early 2027

117.old: FVRL’s page lists Sunday 1 to 5 p.m., Monday to Thursday 9 a.m. to 8 p.m., and Friday and Saturday 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. Hours change on holidays, so check before you go
117.new: The FVRL page gives Monday to Thursday as 9 a.m. to 8 p.m., Friday and Saturday as 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., and Sunday as 1 to 5 p.m. Holidays can change these hours, so confirm before heading over

132.old: Lot size (MLS sales data, not an official source): the median lot size of detached houses sold between July 1 and October 8, 2026 was 68,738 sq ft, based on 6 sales with a recorded lot size. That is about 1.6 acres.
132.new: This comes from MLS sales data and is not an official source. During the period from July 1 to October 8, 2026, detached houses sold had a median lot size of 68,738 sq ft, or about 1.6 acres, across 6 sales that had a recorded lot size.

144.old: Where the water comes from (a well or a water service), the septic system, drainage and the driveway and road access
144.new: Road and driveway access, drainage, the septic system, and whether the property is supplied by a well or by a water service.

146.old: For well and septic records and the last inspection, and what the zone and the ALR status allow on the land
146.new: Well and septic records, plus the last inspection, plus what the ALR status and the zone permit on the land

152.old: The City adopted Official Community Plan Bylaw 6405-2026 on June 1, 2026. It replaces and repeals Bylaw 6350-2025, which the City’s public notice says is substantively the same plan.
152.new: Mission’s Official Community Plan was adopted by the City as Bylaw 6405-2026 on June 1, 2026, replacing and repealing Bylaw 6350-2025. The City’s public notice states that the earlier plan is substantively the same.

159.old: The BC Government’s District of Mission Land Use Inventory (2011) records 1,539 hectares of Agricultural Land Reserve in Mission, close to seven percent of the District’s land area.
159.new: The BC Government’s 2011 Land Use Inventory for the District of Mission puts 1,539 hectares of Mission in the Agricultural Land Reserve. That is roughly seven percent of the District’s land.

163.old: Look up the exact address on the Agricultural Land Commission map and ask the City what the zone allows, including the size and siting of a house.
163.new: On the Agricultural Land Commission map, look up the exact address, then ask the City what the zone permits, such as how large a house can be and where it can sit.

189.old: BC Transit’s Central Fraser Valley route list includes Mission routes 31 Valley Connector, 32 West Heights, 33 Cedar Valley, 34 East Side, 35 Hatzic and 39 Shopper Shuttle.
189.new: In the Central Fraser Valley route list from BC Transit, Mission is served by 35 Hatzic, 31 Valley Connector, 39 Shopper Shuttle, 33 Cedar Valley, 32 West Heights and 34 East Side.

190.old: TransLink says the West Coast Express travels between Downtown Vancouver and Mission City on weekdays during morning and evening rush hours, westbound only in the mornings and eastbound only in the afternoon and evening.
190.new: For getting to Downtown Vancouver, TransLink lists the West Coast Express, which goes between there and Mission City on weekday mornings and evenings during rush hour. Mornings it only goes west, and the afternoon and evening service only goes east.

191.old: Mission City Station is at 33200 North Railway Avenue, and the buses that connect to it are operated by BC Transit.
191.new: The address of Mission City Station is 33200 North Railway Avenue, and BC Transit runs the bus service connecting to it.

195.old: École Mission Senior Secondary (Grades 10 to 12, 32939 7th Avenue) is the district’s senior secondary school on the Province’s list. A replacement school with 1,500 seats is planned for the same site, and Infrastructure BC lists the project as under construction.
195.new: École Mission Senior Secondary is at 32939 7th Avenue and teaches Grades 10 to 12; the Province’s list names it as the district’s senior secondary school. Planned for the same site is a replacement school with 1,500 seats, which Infrastructure BC lists as under construction.

201.old: The City adopted Official Community Plan Bylaw 6405-2026 on June 1, 2026. It replaces and repeals Bylaw 6350-2025, which the City’s public notice says is substantively the same plan.
201.new: Bylaw 6405-2026, adopted June 1, 2026, is the City’s current Official Community Plan. Bylaw 6350-2025 was repealed and replaced by it; the public notice from the City says the two plans are substantively the same.

209.old: Lot size (MLS sales data, not an official source): the median lot size of detached houses sold between July 1 and October 8, 2026 was 68,738 sq ft, based on 6 sales with a recorded lot size. That is about 1.6 acres.
209.new: This is MLS sales data and not an official source. The median lot size was 68,738 sq ft for detached houses sold in the stretch from July 1 to October 8, 2026. The figure rests on 6 sales with a recorded lot size, and it works out to about 1.6 acres.
